review:
A Fourth of July cookout on BGaming's pay-anywhere engine – burgers and grill gear, refilling reels, fireworks in the free spins. Symbols pay wherever they land.

Random multipliers from 2x to 500x can drop in both the base game and the bonus, which keeps every spin a bit unpredictable. Chance x2 makes scatters more frequent for a 25% higher stake. Very high volatility with a 5,000x max, an excellent 97.17% RTP, and free spins roughly once every 162 spins. Plays a lot like Tramp Day and Gemhalla, with a summer-party skin.
pros: Excellent 97.17% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
